mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to add a new bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of adding a new bathroom depends significantly on factors such as its size, fixture quality, material choices, and necessary plumbing or electrical extensions. A basic addition might start from $25,000, while a high-end, custom bathroom could exceed $50,000. We provide a transparent, detailed estimate after understanding your specific requirements and surveying the site.
